title: Doesn't seem quite right.
text: Doesn't seem quite right.. I ended up returning this because I needed it for melting chocolate/candy making and the bottom of the top pot seems WAY too close to the bottom of the bottom pot.  My chocolate kept getting too hot because of this.. even on the lowest burner setting. :/  The refund was swift.  Ty for that!

product_metadata.title: Norpro Universal Stainless Steel Double Boiler, 3-Quart, One Size, As Shown
features: Made of durable stainless steel, this boiler features a long, sturdy, stay cool handle and dual sculpted pour spouts for right or left hand, spill-free pouring.
Gently melt butter, cheese, caramel, chocolate and other candies or warming milk. Perfectly cook your sauces, gravies, yogurt, pudding, custards and more!
Also ideal for candle making, homemade soap, wax tarts and other bath products.
Large capacity with a stable, flat bottom. Great for larger batches without the worry of spillover.
Fits a wide variety of pan depths and diameters.
